name: Fabric Manufacture I
description: Introduction to various fabric manufacturing principles, weaving, knitting, nonwoven and braiding; stages of woven fabric manufacturing: winding, warping, sizing and weaving. Winding: precision and random winding, digicone winding, yarn tensioning and clearing. Warping: direct and sectional warping. Sizing: size materials, sizing machines. Basic fabric construction: elementary woven constructions, drafting and lifting plans. Primary motions of looms: cam shedding, cam designs, dobby and jacquared systems, picking systems in shuttle, air-jet, water-jet and rapier looms, beat up; secondary and auxiliary motions.
